pane-capacity.result: scenarios columns, rows, mixed all pass

scope: Rectangles keeps the focused pane plus the newest leaves that fit instead of collapsing the whole layout to focus.

tests/layout_capacity.lisp property-tests the pure transform; dock_capacity.lisp covers whole-tile dock placement and the overflow chip against a stub; pane_capacity.py exercises a live daemon with 16 panes (cramped hiding, geometry and PTY validity, zoom, chip, window-list click, PID stability on restore).
limitations: Hidden panes are reached through the taskbar window list, Alt-Tab, Super-1..9 or a larger terminal; they keep their PTYs and dimensions while hidden.
The overflow chip lists windows in activation order; the live test clicks rows until the hidden pane is focused rather than asserting row order.
